results.name: Six views, the synthetic banner and the authority boundary render without errors
Exactly one scope container and no duplicated application shell
The fixed clock is stated and never drifts to the real time
The six attention queues render with counts and toggle the register
Non-sortable columns carry no sort control, as parseDirectory refuses them
Sorting by a permitted column reorders the register and announces aria-sort
Search matches an organisation name and a role label through the affiliation JSON
An empty result offers recovery and never reads as a permission problem
The status filter offers exactly the contract statuses
The page size offers exactly 25, 50 and 100
An inactive contact is marked and states that no command can change it
The site technician sees exactly one contact and nine withheld
Restricted renders as restricted, never as empty
The restricted explanation names the failing clause without naming the person
A stakeholder list shows restricted rows beside a permitted one
The visibility explanation traces both clauses for the site technician
A company reader satisfies both clauses, and the basis names the first
The contact record states the absent reference and the absent command
Affiliation concurrency is stated as belonging to the organisation
A stale organisation version produces a conflict, not a silent write
An ended affiliation shows its period and whether a successor is recorded
The reliance view lists every binding with its owning module
An inactive primary contact shows a blocked approval owned by SV-06
A finance-held binding is restricted for a non-finance reader and shown for finance
Authority basis renders one of three values and explains itself
Coverage gaps name a site without a primary contact and its consequence
An organisation with history but no current affiliation is a stated gap
A proposal refuses a short reason and keeps what was entered
A proposal cannot be reviewed by its proposer
Every apply is confirmed, labelled Simulated, and changes no record
A returned proposal produces a successor that inherits no review
Duplicate resolution proposes a pointer and merges nothing
A duplicate candidate set the reader cannot reach is withheld, not hidden
Two people who share a name are listed separately and never auto-merged
A role without shared.edit cannot raise a proposal, and says why
Loading, failed, partial and denied states are distinct and never read as zero
A failed save keeps entries and changes nothing
A competing tab raises a conflict that overwrites nothing
The assistant refuses to answer from a stale copy
The assistant answers only from the rendered record
A refused restore changes nothing and says why
Reset returns to the built-in fixture and discards local proposals
A dialog returns focus to the control that opened it
A panel returns focus and closes on Escape
A proposal can be completed with the keyboard alone
A duplicate review can be completed with the keyboard alone
Cancelling a changed form asks before discarding
The skip link reaches the workspace content
No horizontal overflow at 1440x960
No horizontal overflow at 1024x768
No horizontal overflow at 820x800
No horizontal overflow at 390x844
Phone targets meet the 44 px minimum
The register becomes cards on the phone viewport with labelled fields
The inspection panel is full width on the phone viewport
A dialog fits the phone viewport without overflow
No page error, console error or failed request occurred during the run
